issues.where: the ochre band ringing the basin, especially the broad left coves
issues.what: the nearly solid ochre ribbon fades through brown to navy around much of the basin, like a painted shoreline mask rather than water of varying depth
issues.fix: drive the water color by actual bathymetry and sediment, with irregular transitions and localized surface detail

issues.where: the headland and cove in the lower-left crop
issues.what: a thin pale outline traces the coast at nearly constant width, with little sign of wet rock or water breaking against it
issues.fix: replace the outline with a wet margin and discontinuous shore breaks that follow local slope and exposure

issues.where: the ridges in the lower-left crop
issues.what: rock detail smears across slopes, and neighboring ridges share the same charcoal grooves and tan grain, making the terrain look like a draped map texture
issues.fix: give exposed rock and scree distinct materials and add slope-specific relief and sharper breakup

issues.where: the open water in the left crop
issues.what: only broad soft streaks break up the navy surface; there is no convincing directional glint or smaller wave structure
issues.fix: add multiscale wind ripples with restrained specular response and a direction consistent with the shoreline conditions
